notes.title: Rallycross Circuits & Cross Platform Multiplayer
notes.notes:
Hello Rush Rally fans,

It's been a while, but we've been busy working on two massive features! [b]Rallycross circuits[/b] and [b]Cross Platform Multiplayer[/b].

Since launch, we've had quite a few requests for a [b]rallycross [/b]game mode (we actually wanted to do rallycross from the start but didn't quite have the time to do it properly). With the latest update, you'll have access to 3 challenging rallycross cups, each with 6 circuits, for a total of 18 new tracks! That's 72 new medals to fight for, and 36 new leaderboards to climb to the top of. As well as a brand new rallycross race championship mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41424450/ff5f31d84a31d2511d9a984baef99dbbbd072814.png[/img]

And if that wasn't enough to keep you busy, we've also introduced [b]cross platform multiplayer[/b] which will help increase those multiplayer lobby numbers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41424450/039dfb81b84c4fb30207c124e90dacff7a801f13.png[/img]

In addition, we've also added support for wheels (please note, that not all will be working, so please check out the demo to verify). Turned on [b]cloud saves[/b], as well as lots of bug fixes and other small improvements - check out the additional stage vegetation!

We're looking forward to seeing you on track in the multiplayer mode :)

notes.title: Rush Rally 3 Available NOW!
notes.notes:
[h3]Good news Rush Rally fans, Rush Rally 3 is now available on Steam![/h3]

[h2][b]Experience the Rush[/b][/h2]
60 FPS racing (120fps on supported devices) at night or day in the rain or snow! Over 100 new and unique stages each with different surface types including snow, gravel, tarmac and dirt! Race with one of the best car dynamics models to date, including real time vehicle deformation and damage, built from over 15 years of experience. 

Race with your favourite controller, all fully configurable including full force feedback wheel support!

[h2][b]World Rally Racing[/b][/h2]
Take on the Career mode, race a Single Rally over many countries or grind metal to metal with other cars in Rally Cross.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2020860/extras/inplace_2.png?t=1669296617[/img]

[h2][b]Live Events[/b][/h2]
Compete in weekly events against other players all over the world on a unique selection of tracks!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2020860/extras/inplace_3.png?t=1669296617[/img]

[h2][b]Build your Garage[/b][/h2]
Upgrade, tune and customise a garage of over 20 different cars. Use the livery editor to completely change the look of your vehicles. Buy new wheels and upgrades to make each car truly unique.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2020860/extras/inplace_4.png?t=1669296617[/img]

[h2][b]Compete with Friends, Multiplayer and Offline[/b][/h2]
Real-time cross platform multiplayer, Social Leaderboards and Ghost Racing allow you to race any player at any time. See how you compare with the world's best.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2020860/

notes.title: Rush Rally Origins Available NOW!
notes.notes:
[h3]Good news race fans, Rush Rally Origins is available NOW![/h3]

[previewyoutube=GNOn04kTcfg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Realistic Top Down Rallying[/b][/h3]
Rush Rally Origins combines the classic top down racing action from the original Rush Rally with the highly praised graphics and physics from Rush Rally 3. Take on 48 new and unique stages across the world, each with the ability to change the time of day and weather. Drive over many challenging surface types including snow, gravel, dirt, mud and tarmac!

[h3][b]Experience the Rush[/b][/h3]
Race at 60fps (120fps on supported devices) with one of the best car dynamics models to date, highly tuned for Rush Rally Origins to give a more fun top down racing experience. Feel the grip change across different surface types and multiple weather conditions.

[h3][b]World Rally Racing[/b][/h3]
Compete in a series of rally championships, race against others in our unique A-B Race mode or hold your nerve and focus on improving your times in the time trial game modes.

[h3][b]Compete with Friends, Multiplayer and Offline[/b][/h3]
Real-time multiplayer, social leaderboards and ghost racing allow you to race any player at any time. See how you compare with the world's best.

[h3][b]Upgrade Your Cars[/b][/h3]
Unlock and upgrade a selection of classic Rush Rally cars. Use our simple upgrade system to tailor each car to your own specific driving style.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1728660/
